, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the manipulated variable—speed—as the dependent variable. Since the physicist deliberately changes the car’s speed across trials, speed is the independent (manipulated) variable; the outcome (e.g., successful jump/distance) is the dependent variable. This led to the wrong choice (B instead of D).
